svg.text: Six New Machines to Dream About
each one changes a rule, not just a colour

g.text: Six machines exist. These are six that could.

text.tspan: A new machine is not a new colour of cabinet — it is a new reason to play. Each of these changes one
rule of the pit, so the arcade gets deeper instead of just longer. The cuties inside are not drawn yet,
and that part is Ella’s job.
One cat wakes up now and then
and bats the pile around while
The pit is full of water.
down after a miss instead of
two more into the air. Chaos,
find out what you caught when

g.text: Ella picks: which one is machine number 7 · what the eight cuties inside are called · which twist is worth building first

svg.text: Made for Ella — Creator, Owner & Game Boss
